topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This topic introduces the lecture, outlines the learning outcomes, and establishes the conceptual framework of cancer evolution.

topics.label: Cell-Intrinsic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic alterations enable competitive clonal expansion and progression toward malignancy.

topics.label: Tissue Hierarchies and the Cell of Origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how normal tissue hierarchies and stem cell properties influence cancer initiation and tumor-propagating potential.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Drivers of Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how inflammatory signals and supportive microenvironmental cells promote neoplastic transformation and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Microenvironments and Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This topic examines the experimental and spatial technologies used to profile clonal evolution and cellular interactions within tumor tissues.

topics.label: Synthesizing the Multidimensional Drivers of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This topic synthesizes the multiple converging factors that drive clonal selection and cancer evolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This topic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
